shortDescription: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang responded on X to reports that H100 rental prices have risen, saying the company’s computing resources are easy to trade, durable, and highly valuable to rent. According to Odaily, earlier reports said NVIDIA’s H100 training chip rental price increased 22% to $3.28 per hour.
